Hi Jordan 

Thanks again for taking time on the call this morning. Quick recap and the items we discussed so procurement can move forward: 

1) Vendor setup packet: attached (vendor_setup_packet.pdf)  this includes our W-9, standard vendor form and bank details template.
2) Payment method: you mentioned your preferred path is PO / Net 30 for platform vendors. Can you confirm whether Acme requires us to be a named vendor (vendor code) or if procurement prefers to buy through AWS Marketplace?
3) Commercial terms: Rishi will follow up on any discount/deal-specific paperwork, but from a procurement standpoint we generally accept PO/ACH/net terms for enterprise deals. We also support purchasing via credit card for pilot/trial.
4) Next steps: if you can confirm (a) vendor packet recipient and (b) whether your team needs a ACH/Banking form completed, well get the packet over to your vendor portal and set up DocuSign for the SOW/PO path.

Attached: vendor_setup_packet.pdf, W-9_Redwood_Inference.pdf, bank_details_form.xlsx

If it helps, I can also provide the Redwood AWS Marketplace listing link for procurement to route through a marketplace purchase.

Thanks  look forward to getting this into your vendor portal.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa 

Thanks for the packet. A few quick clarifications from procurement: 

- We generally prefer PO/Net30 for SaaS vendors.

- Regarding AWS Marketplace: our platform procurement team sometimes requires marketplace purchases for specific cost center flows. Can you share your AWS Marketplace seller ID / listing URL so we can evaluate?

If you can send the populated banking form and a short note on whether Redwood is willing to accept PO (Net30) vs only card for the initial pilot, well queue it.
